snippet.title: Doggy Drifts
snippet.description:
Welcome to Doggy Drifts! 🐾

As a dedicated dog lover, I created this channel to help fellow owners understand their furry best friends on a deeper level. I believe that the more we know about our dogs, the stronger our bond becomes and the happier their lives will be.

On this channel, I share personal experiences from my own life with dogs, combined with valuable insights and professional advice gathered from my network of veterinarians and fellow dog experts. Whether it’s decoding mysterious behaviors, health tips, or understanding the emotional world of your pet, Doggy Drifts is here to provide you with the information you need to be the best "parent" your dog could ask for.

Thank you for being part of our journey! If you love dogs as much as we do, please Subscribe and join our community of passionate dog owners.

snippet.title: Life With Klee Kai
snippet.description:
Copper and Skye are two Alaskan Klee Kai dogs who are small in stature but have big personalities.

Skye, our black and white Alaskan Klee Kai, was born in September 2017, is the older sibling and likes to think she's the boss of the house. Women power!

Her little brother Copper, who is our red and white Alaskan Klee Kai pup, completed our little family in early 2018. He is five months younger than Skye, but they share the same Dad,  who was a red Klee Kai like Copper.

Alaskan Klee Kai is a breed growing in popularity, although we're often asked if Copper and Skye are a Husky puppies, a Chihuahua and Husky mix or Pomsky dogs.

We hope that our channel, Life With Klee Kai, can shed light on our experience with the breed, providing information and plenty of laughs.

snippet.title: Howtown
snippet.description:
The "How Do They Know" show from journalists Adam Cole and Joss Fong.

You may have seen our work with Vox, NPR's Skunk Bear, and Netflix "Explained". Now we've left those jobs and work directly for you. These are our principles:

Curiosity-driven: We are not searching for evidence to support a position that we've already chosen. We are here to understand what it takes to answer interesting questions and to help you navigate what we know so far.

Primary sources: We read all of the research that we cover, and we interview those involved in that work (Researchers: please answer our emails!)

Accountability: In the case of any factual errors, we will post corrections directly under the relevant video that explain what we got wrong. 

Independence: Outside of shorts, we will not accept offers for spon-con/native advertising, in which the video itself exists to serve the sponsor. The ad read is the only part of the video that sponsors review. 

To support this project, find us on Patreon.

snippet.title: Jaw-Dropping Facts
snippet.description:
In this channel, I create educational videos about pets and explain proper ways to care for them. I have a doctoral degree and I keep the content of this channel scientific and well-researched. I am a pet expert, and spend many hours writing original scripts to convey true and informative content about pets. I use voice-over and my own custom original animations to visually explain the concepts.

I also upload videos known as dog TV and cat TV to keep your pets entertained. All the footage, music, visuals and audio in these videos are recorded by myself. The relaxing music in these videos is our original composition created by us through improvisation and playing piano. Here is behind-the-scenes: https://youtu.be/2Jd-AefQy4A

Finally, I also upload videos of sounds (e.g. cats meowing sounds, dogs barking sounds) to stimulate your pets. ALL the clips and sounds in these videos are original and recorded by me exclusively for my channel, and all rights are reserved (no reused allowed)

snippet.title: TEDx Talks
snippet.description:
TEDx is an international community that organizes TED-style events anywhere and everywhere -- celebrating locally-driven ideas and elevating them to a global stage. TEDx events are produced independently of TED conferences, each event curates speakers on their own, but based on TED's format and rules.

For more information on using TED for commercial purposes (e.g. employee learning, in a film or online course), please submit a Media Request here: https://media-requests.ted.com.
